title: Build Your Own Filter
instructions:
Write a function called `myFilter` that takes two parameters:
- `items` of type `List<Int>`
- `predicate` of type `(Int) -> Boolean`

The function should return a new `List<Int>` containing only the elements where `predicate` returns `true`.

For example:
- `myFilter(listOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), { it > 3 })` returns `[4, 5]`
- `myFilter(listOf(10, 15, 20, 25), { it >= 20 })` returns `[20, 25]`
hint: Create a mutable list. Loop through items. If predicate(item) is true, add the item to the result list. Return the result.
